content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The Agreement contains no indemnification section at all — the numbering jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability), while Sections 9.3 ("remedies required by Section 20.5"), 19.4 ("indemnified claims"), 21.3 ("its indemnification obligations") and 30.5 ("vested indemnity rights") all assume indemnities exist. That is walk-away territory under INDEMN, so I classified it as **missing** and inserted a single new Section 20.1 at the **preferred** level: Vendor defence/indemnity for Customer and its Affiliates covering IP infringement by the Services or Deliverables, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorised access to Customer Data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus notice, defence-control and cooperation mechanics and a cap on any Customer indemnity.

I did not take the fallback because its 3× annual-fees super-cap would cut into Section 21.3, which currently leaves indemnification obligations uncapped in our favour. The dangling Section 20.5 cross-reference in Section 9.3 is flagged in the rationale for negotiation rather than cured by importing fallback-only procure/modify/replace remedies.
